objective: Keep every ordinary BUKLOD Main desktop dashboard centered in the persistent web chrome; restore Cluster workspace, correctly-sized left navigation, desktop Connect Enter-to-send, and safely contained centered Character Customize editor.
productionBaselineEvidence: Current GitHub Main source 99df54a39b688e367cd64b22f8a64eb09085e019 inspected against user screenshots from 2026-11-07: scoped Cluster showed blank top and full page; Points left desktop chrome and Profile back was inconsistent; Character Customize produced SYS-500 render boundary; desktop chat uses multiline with no Enter send handler. These screenshots do not establish the live Expo deployment commit.
chosenApproach: Route /scope, /points and ordinary profile/member/Connect dashboard details through existing persistent desktop shell at >=1200px. Widen only left rail with minimum center width. Suppress mobile safe-area padding inside desktop scope child. Add web-only Enter keyboard handler with guard against duplicate submits and composition. Lazy-load and crash-isolate existing Character Studio; use a centered bounded modal rather than replacing Profile or rewriting character data.
selectionRationale: Route mismatch between two web shells caused full-page escapes; phone status-bar inset belongs to native. Character Studio must not be allowed to crash all of BUKLOD. Retaining canonical post/Connect/character engines and mobile fallback avoids divergent implementations and data migration.
alternativeApproaches: Navigate desktop Points and Cluster to standalone fullscreen pages: rejected because main dashboard continuity is required.
Rewrite Connect composer and Character data engine: rejected due duplication and account/data risks.
Remove Character customization button: rejected because it was functional previously and must remain available.
preserveBehaviors: Approved canonical BUKLOD image and desktop shell unchanged
Unfinished DEV and other current Main branches unmodified
Android/native chat keyboard and mobile web multiline behavior retained
Existing Connect send handler and attachment/reaction paths retained
Character selection/storage, points accounting and native character editor preserved
Cluster access guards, community posts and scope authorizations preserved
PWA favicon, ads, SOS, Wall media and Classroom boundaries unchanged
No database/Android OTA or production-hosting deployment from DEV
acceptanceChecks: Desktop at >=1200px uses one centered shell for Home, Cluster, Points, profile settings and Connect details
Desktop Cluster header does not reserve enormous top inset; cluster tabs remain functional
Points-to-Profile/back keeps the same desktop chrome
Left rail wider and center remains at least 635px at representative sizes
Web Enter sends populated draft once, ignores blank drafts, composing, shift and repeats
Character customization mounts lazily, editor bounded to center, render error isolated with retry/close; no silent data mutation
All CI/typecheck/web export and focused regression gates pass before release
